notes.title: 1.6 update
notes.content:
[b]Improvements[/b]
[list]
[*] Fix missing avatar hands on HTC Vive and other non-Oculus headsets.
[*] Add instructions and hints to all levels to make it easier to learn how to get through the level.
[*] 1-5: Add missing wall collider that allowed a shortcut. High scores taking this shortcut has been reset.
[/list]

notes.title: Improved colliders in the city
notes.content: We've gone through literally tons of buildings and tweaked the colliders to better match the visuals, so you should no longer hit any invisible walls when cutting corners or passing through tight corridors.

notes.title: Swinger-Man is live on Steam!
notes.content:
We're biased of course, but we think this game brings something really new to VR.

There is no comfortable setting here and the easy difficulty is still hard af, but once you master the skills with precision the rewards will be that more sweet.

Go check out the store page for a trailer and some screenshots. If you love yourself some time trials and fancy swinging in the most innocent sense of the word, then this is the game for you!

We are working hard on a new trailer video to better show you what it's all about, so if you're still on the fence stay tuned for that.

Cheers!
